verdict.rationale: Smithery's docs describe managed OAuth in which Smithery maintains the OAuth apps and no client IDs or secrets are configured. Nothing shows customers can bring their own OAuth app credentials or apply their own branding to the authorization flow. The hosted connection services were also shut down on October 31, 2026, so no current auth flow exists to white-label.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can white-label the authorization flow with my own branding and my own OAuth app credentials
